### Cisco and OpenAI launch Shirudo open-source infrastructure shield to prevent AI-driven cyberattacks
- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/6e09bfc0943aff4c
- Primary Source: SiliconANGLE (https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/23/cisco-and-openai-launch-shirudo-an-open-source-infrastructure-shield-to-protect-against-ai-driven-cyberattacks/)

This initiative addresses the critical threat where AI-driven vulnerability exploitation precedes public disclosure, shifting security from reactive patching to resilient, design-based protection.
- Key Verified Facts:

* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To counter the threat of AI-driven cyberattacks that outpace traditional manual patching
* [Key Fact Detail] Core driver: Addressing the negative time window for vulnerability exploitation caused by AI-driven automation.
* [Industry Impact & Outlook] Future impact: Shifting the industry toward a 'Secure-by-Design' paradigm instead of reactive patching.

- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/a5b5d919389f91d5

The attack, occurring between October 11-12, caused widespread equipment failures, fires, and tens of millions of euros in food losses, marking a transition from espionage to physical infrastructure sabotage.

* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Systematic targeting of critical civilian infrastructure violating international norms
* [Key Fact Detail] Attribution to the Iranian IRGC-affiliated SHAHID KAVEH unit.
* [Key Position & Outlook] First large-scale cyber-sabotage campaign targeting civilian infrastructure in Europe.
